name: deprecate_warn
title: Warn that a function was deprecated. The package is <NA> at the top level.

origin.description: Warn that a function was deprecated. The package is <NA> at the top level.
origin.details: Warn that a function was deprecated. The package is <NA> at the top level.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(lifecycle))
cat("`foo()` was deprecated in <NA> 1.0.0. / \u2139 Please use `bar()` instead.")
